capabilities.name: Worker specification validation
capabilities.description: Validates worker and task references plus bounded CPU, memory, wall-time and output budgets.

capabilities.name: Worker lifecycle supervision
capabilities.description: Supervises adapter-backed worker submissions through pending, running, succeeded and failed states.

capabilities.name: Bounded worker admission controls
capabilities.description: Applies fail-closed boolean-only policy checks and bounds active plus queued work to at most 256 workers and 4,096 combined slots.
limitations: Policy callback is an integration seam, not a production policy service.
No authenticated principal verification or protected-resource enforcement is implemented.
Resource budgets are validated admission metadata until a trusted sandbox adapter enforces them.

capabilities.name: Adapter health reporting
capabilities.description: Reports adapter health and supervisor capacity without asserting workload trust.

explicit_non_capabilities: durable or distributed queues and scheduling
authenticated audit ingestion or signed provenance
